data.text: Kate, yes—I’ll join the 10-ton agreement. My family taught me to fish this lake, and I want our village’s children to inherit a livelihood, not an empty lake. Luke, ten tons a month earns you $100,000 over ten months while keeping that income available afterward. Taking everything offers no such future. Before anyone heads out, can we all explicitly commit to a 50-ton total, with 10 tons each? Luke, will you join us?
